import numpy as np
np.set_printoptions(precision=3, suppress=True, linewidth=220)
W = dict(np.load("weights.npz"))
def svd(M): return np.linalg.svd(M, full_matrices=False)
OV0 = [W["W_o.0"][:,64*j:64*j+64] @ W["W_v.0"][64*j:64*j+64,:] for j in range(6)]
U,S,Vt = svd(np.vstack([o/np.linalg.norm(o) for o in OV0]))
T = Vt[:30].T   # input-side token(+?) subspace, 384x30
Up,Sp,Vpt = svd(W["W_proj.3"])
O = Up[:,:30]   # output-side logit subspace
def cosines(A,B):
    return np.linalg.svd(A.T@B, compute_uv=False)
print("principal cosines T(in, 30) vs O(out W_proj.3, 30):", cosines(T,O))
rnd = np.linalg.qr(np.random.randn(384,30))[0]
print("random baseline:", cosines(T,rnd)[:5])
# Q, K per head in layer 0: fraction of squared Frobenius norm in T, and sv of Q,K restricted
for j in range(6):
    Q = W["W_q.0"][64*j:64*j+64]; K = W["W_k.0"][64*j:64*j+64]; V = W["W_v.0"][64*j:64*j+64]
    fq = np.linalg.norm(Q@T)**2/np.linalg.norm(Q)**2
    fk = np.linalg.norm(K@T)**2/np.linalg.norm(K)**2
    fv = np.linalg.norm(V@T)**2/np.linalg.norm(V)**2
    B = Q.T@K
    fB = np.linalg.norm(T.T@B@T)**2/np.linalg.norm(B)**2
    print(f"head {j}: frac in T: Q={fq:.3f} K={fk:.3f} V={fv:.3f}  QK in TxT={fB:.3f} (random expect {30/384:.3f}, TxT {(30/384)**2:.4f})")
    # top singular vectors of Q and K: overlap with T
    uq,sq,vq = svd(Q); uk,sk,vk = svd(K)
    print("   Q top8 sv:", sq[:8], " frac of top-8 right sv in T:", np.round((np.linalg.norm(vq[:8]@T,axis=1))**2,2))
    print("   K top8 sv:", sk[:8], " frac of top-8 right sv in T:", np.round((np.linalg.norm(vk[:8]@T,axis=1))**2,2))
